edition: A02 The Full ROI Equation for AI Agents
note: Synthetic data. value = python = r, rounded to digits (2 -> 0.01, -3 -> nearest 1,000). Both languages read the same Monte Carlo uniforms (data/mc_uniforms.csv), so simulation results match exactly.
